description.short: Ask about access in plain language.
description.full: Ask Identity Atlas who has access to what, in English or Dutch, and get the answer in this chat. Questions are turned into a report by a model running on your own infrastructure — nothing you ask leaves it, and the model never sees your data, only your question. Experimental: answers can take a couple of minutes, and roughly one question in seven comes back wrong, so every answer states what it understood before it shows the rows.
